name: diskarte-monorepo
description: Diskarte monorepo — two independently deployed Next.js apps (diskarte/ on Render, early-access-portal/ on Vercel) sharing supabase/

scripts.install:all: npm ci --prefix diskarte && npm ci --prefix early-access-portal
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix diskarte && npm run build --prefix early-access-portal
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix diskarte && npm run lint --prefix early-access-portal
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix diskarte && npm run typecheck --prefix early-access-portal
scripts.test: npm test --prefix diskarte && npm test --prefix early-access-portal
